foundations.title: Business Creation & Digital Foundations — One-on-One
foundations.headline: Build your business, from idea to launch.
foundations.audience: Aspiring entrepreneurs, existing business owners and future digital agency founders. Build a shop, local service, tourism venture, ecommerce business or digital service around your own idea.

modules.title: Week 1 · Business setup, agency foundations & Digi Assist AI
modules.body: Validate your business idea, plan your brand, pricing, registration and banking, introduce your digital agency offer and master the Digi Assist AI workspace.

modules.title: Week 2 · AI websites & ecommerce
modules.body: Connect your domain, hosting and email; create your business website with AI; build a small ecommerce store and test the enquiry-to-order journey.

modules.title: Week 3 · Google, Facebook & advertising
modules.body: Prepare an eligible Google listing and search plan, set up your Facebook Page and Instagram content, and plan your first Facebook advertisement.

modules.title: Week 4 · Affiliate & digital marketing
modules.body: Choose affiliate offers, make honest recommendations, track referrals and use content, email and analytics to improve customer follow-up.

modules.title: Weeks 5–6 · Video, automation, agency delivery & launch
modules.body: Create AI promotional content, connect chatbots and bookings, manage customer documents, refine ads and package your agency services. Present your working business and launch plan.

sessions.title: Business idea, customers and business model
sessions.body: Choose a customer problem, test demand and define your offer, costs, revenue and pricing.

sessions.title: Business setup, branding and agency foundations
sessions.body: Check your name and domain, plan registration and banking, develop your brand and choose the services your digital agency could offer.

sessions.title: Mastering Digi Assist AI
sessions.body: Practise prompts and the connected website, chatbot, booking, catalogue and business-document workspaces. Build a repeatable way to use AI in your daily work.

sessions.title: Domains, hosting and professional email
sessions.body: Choose and connect a domain, hosting and business email, keeping ownership and recovery details under your control.

sessions.title: Build your business website with AI
sessions.body: Use Digi Assist AI to build clear website pages, useful copy, mobile layouts and a working enquiry route. Review quality and basic search visibility.

sessions.title: Build an ecommerce website
sessions.body: Create a small store with products, descriptions and images. Plan payment options, order confirmation, delivery and returns; test the customer journey.

sessions.title: Google Business Profile, SEO and analytics
sessions.body: Check listing eligibility and ownership, prepare accurate business details and verification steps, and use website SEO and analytics to plan improvements.

sessions.title: Facebook Page, Instagram and content planning
sessions.body: Set up a useful business Page, present your offer and plan content for Facebook and Instagram with a clear customer action.

sessions.title: Facebook and Instagram advertising
sessions.body: Choose an ad objective, audience, budget, creative and destination. Prepare and review a campaign for your own permitted business offer.

sessions.title: Affiliate niches, programmes and disclosures
sessions.body: Choose relevant affiliate programmes and products, understand commission terms and prepare helpful recommendations with clear disclosures.

sessions.title: Affiliate content, links and conversion tracking
sessions.body: Create reviews and comparisons, set up tracked links and review clicks, referrals and conversions. Separate pending, approved and paid income.

sessions.title: Digital marketing, email and customer conversations
sessions.body: Combine useful content, email follow-up and analytics. Practise sales conversations and plan a campaign you can measure and improve.

sessions.title: AI images and promotional video production
sessions.body: Create a branded content brief, script, visual assets and an AI promotional video. Review facts and permissions before publication.

sessions.title: Business chatbots, bookings and service packages
sessions.body: Build a chatbot from approved business facts, connect enquiries and booking requests, and prepare service packages with a clear handover to you.

sessions.title: CRM, quotations, invoices and receipts
sessions.body: Organise leads and customer records, prepare quotes and invoices, record payments and plan follow-up using the demonstrated Digi Assist tools.

sessions.title: Google Ads, retargeting and campaign refinement
sessions.body: Understand search intent and keywords, plan a budget and retargeting, and improve your ad message, landing page and measurement.

sessions.title: Set up and deliver your digital agency services
sessions.body: Package website, ecommerce, marketing and AI services; price your work, prepare a proposal, onboard a client and plan delivery, handover and support.

sessions.title: Business launch, demonstration and review
sessions.body: Show your offer, website or store, marketing and customer workflow. Review results, improve weak points and agree your first month of mentorship priorities.

outcomes: Create a business offer, brand and practical setup plan
Master Digi Assist AI for websites, chatbots, bookings and business documents
Build an AI-powered business website and ecommerce store
Use Google listings, Facebook, digital marketing and affiliate marketing
Create AI images and promotional video, then launch a campaign
Package these skills into your own digital agency services
foundations.overview: Learn the practical business skills Steve teaches in the October cohort, with private guidance and more time to apply them to your own business. Work through the connected process: create your offer, master Digi Assist AI, build your website or store, attract customers and organise delivery. You also learn how to package these skills into a digital agency service.
foundations.projectTitle: Build a business you can demonstrate.
foundations.projectDescription: Bring your own idea or existing business. During class, build your offer, website or ecommerce store, marketing assets and customer enquiry or order process. Finish by demonstrating the complete customer journey and agreeing your next priorities for mentorship.

topics.title: Business creation & your digital agency
topics.description: Turn a business idea into a clear offer, then learn to sell the same practical skills as a service.
skills: Business names, customer research, pricing, branding, registration and banking basics
Set up your digital agency: choose services, create packages and prepare proposals
Plan client onboarding, delivery, handover, support and recurring service work

topics.title: Mastering Digi Assist AI
topics.description: Use Digi Assist AI as a connected workspace for your business, rather than learning isolated features.
skills: Write and refine prompts for planning, research, copy and everyday business tasks
Build pages, a business chatbot, booking flows and a small product catalogue
Create quotations, invoices and customer records; test how the tools work together

topics.title: AI website building & ecommerce
topics.description: Build a professional site or store around what your customers actually need.
skills: Domains, hosting, business email, mobile layouts and clear calls to action
Create and improve website pages, product descriptions and images with AI
Build a store catalogue, plan payments and delivery, and test enquiries and orders

topics.title: Google listings & search visibility
topics.description: Help suitable customers discover your business and know how to contact you.
skills: Check eligibility and ownership before setting up a Google Business Profile
Prepare accurate categories, contact details, hours, photos and verification steps
Learn website SEO, useful search content, analytics and improvements after launch

topics.title: Facebook & digital marketing
topics.description: Build a practical marketing process from your Facebook Page to a customer conversation.
skills: Set up your Facebook business Page and plan Facebook and Instagram content
Prepare ads with an objective, audience, budget, creative and working destination
Combine social media, email follow-up, Google Ads, retargeting and performance review

topics.title: Affiliate marketing
topics.description: Learn to recommend useful products, use tracked links and understand how commissions work.
skills: Choose a niche, suitable affiliate programmes and offers your audience understands
Create helpful reviews, comparisons and campaigns with clear affiliate disclosures
Track clicks, referrals and conversions; distinguish pending, approved and paid commission

topics.title: AI content, images & promotional video
topics.description: Create the assets your business or agency needs to explain and promote an offer.
skills: Write useful website, social and email copy with AI, then review it for accuracy
Plan branded images, graphics and a consistent content calendar
Script and produce an AI promotional video, then use it in a campaign

topics.title: Customer workflows & your launch
topics.description: Connect your marketing to a business that can respond, take bookings and deliver.
skills: Build a helpful chatbot, booking requests and service packages
Organise leads, customer follow-up, quotations, invoices and receipts
Test the full customer journey, protect account access and present your launch project

software.title: AI, Coding & Software Development — One-on-One
software.headline: Build the tools your business needs.
software.audience: Business owners, freelancers and learners ready to use AI, build software, improve WordPress sites and offer automation or training services.

modules.title: Week 1 · Your software idea, AI skills & agent design
modules.body: Choose your own software project, define a practical scope, master prompting and map the tasks your AI agents will carry out.

modules.title: Week 2 · AI agents across your work
modules.body: Build connected customer, CRM and admin workflows. Learn AI video and content production, meeting preparation, note-taking, action summaries and follow-up.

modules.title: Week 3 · WordPress & AI-assisted coding
modules.body: Build and improve WordPress websites with AI, understand code and integrations, and practise reviewing changes and debugging errors.

modules.title: Weeks 4–5 · Build, test & deploy your chosen software
modules.body: Use app builders, code, databases and APIs to implement your project. Test permissions and the user journey, debug errors, deploy a working version and plan pricing and maintenance.

modules.title: Week 6 · Demonstration, AI services & institutional training
modules.body: Show your software and agent workflows, package your services, write a training proposal and deliver a mini-workshop. Plan refinements for your three months of mentorship.

sessions.title: AI fundamentals and practical prompting
sessions.body: Use AI for research, reasoning, content and business tasks. Build reusable prompts and review output against your goals.

sessions.title: Choose and scope your software project
sessions.body: Choose one software idea, define users, screens and the main workflow, and agree what you will build during class.

sessions.title: Design AI agents and automation workflows
sessions.body: Map the work you want to delegate. Define agent instructions, connected tools, permissions and review steps; scope an automation audit.

sessions.title: Customer-service agents, chatbots and bookings
sessions.body: Build a useful assistant for enquiries and bookings, ground it in business facts and test handover and follow-up.

sessions.title: CRM, marketing and administrative agents
sessions.body: Connect leads, email, documents and follow-up. Build focused workflows for quotations, invoices or other repeated administrative tasks.

sessions.title: AI video, content and meeting assistants
sessions.body: Connect tools for research, scripts, video production and meeting preparation. Practise scheduling and supported assistants that join meetings, capture notes, and produce summaries, action lists and follow-up drafts.

sessions.title: AI-assisted WordPress planning
sessions.body: Plan a WordPress website, pages, plugins and a clear customer journey for your own business or a client.

sessions.title: Build and improve WordPress with AI
sessions.body: Use AI for content, layouts and useful integrations such as forms, bookings or ecommerce; review quality and troubleshoot errors.

sessions.title: AI-assisted coding foundations
sessions.body: Read, adapt and debug code with AI. Understand project files, versions, errors and how to review the changes you accept.

sessions.title: No-code and AI application builders
sessions.body: Start your chosen software project using appropriate app-building tools. Build its screens and first working user journey.

sessions.title: Databases, user accounts and APIs
sessions.body: Connect your project data, accounts and external services, using suitable permissions and access controls.

sessions.title: Build your chosen software project
sessions.body: Implement the main workflow of your own app or business programme, then connect the integrations or AI agent that support it.

sessions.title: Testing, debugging and project quality
sessions.body: Test your main user journey, data access and common failures. Fix problems and review security and reliability basics.

sessions.title: Deploy your software and connected workflows
sessions.body: Publish a working version, connect the services it needs and plan hosting, maintenance and support.

sessions.title: Pricing, licensing and AI service delivery
sessions.body: Package and price your software, automation audits and support. Prepare a clear scope, client handover and service plan.

sessions.title: Design AI training for businesses and institutions
sessions.body: Create a practical curriculum around real tasks for a business, government or community audience.

sessions.title: Workshop facilitation and training proposals
sessions.body: Practise demonstrations, exercises and facilitation; write a clear institutional training proposal.

sessions.title: Software, AI agent and mini-training showcase
sessions.body: Demonstrate your chosen software and connected AI workflow, deliver a short training and plan improvements for the mentorship period.

outcomes: Build, test and deploy one software project of your choice in class
Use AI-assisted coding, databases, accounts and APIs
Set up AI agents for customer service, marketing and administration
Create AI video and meeting-assistance workflows with connected tools
Build and improve WordPress websites and integrations
Price and deliver software, automation services and institutional AI training
software.overview: Learn the AI, coding and delivery skills Steve uses in his own work. Build one software project of your choice during class and connect AI agents to practical business workflows. The training combines building, testing and deployment with content, video, meetings, customer service and administration.
software.projectTitle: Your idea. One software project built in class.
software.projectDescription: Choose a software idea that matters to you: for example, a booking system, stock tracker, customer portal, business dashboard or AI assistant. Agree a practical scope with Steve, then build its main workflow, connect its data, test it and deploy a working version during the programme. Use the three months of mentorship afterwards to refine and extend it.
projectSteps: Choose your software and define its scope
Build the main workflow with AI and code
Connect data, tools and AI agents
Test, deploy and demonstrate your project

topics.title: Build software of your choice
topics.description: Work on one chosen project throughout class, from a real problem to a working deployed version.
skills: Define your users, screens, features and the main journey you want to solve
Use AI app builders and coding tools to turn your idea into a working product
Demonstrate your project, identify improvements and plan its next stage

topics.title: AI-assisted coding, databases & APIs
topics.description: Understand what you are building so you can review changes, solve errors and maintain it.
skills: Read and adapt code; understand files, versions, errors and debugging
Connect databases, user accounts and APIs with appropriate access controls
Test the main user journey, deploy your software and plan hosting and maintenance

topics.title: AI agents for your everyday work
topics.description: Set up connected assistants that carry out useful tasks across your business tools.
skills: Map your workload and build agents for enquiries, leads, bookings and customer follow-up
Connect CRM, documents, email and administrative tasks such as quotations and invoices
Design clear instructions, tool access, review steps and a route back to you

topics.title: Video, content & meeting workflows
topics.description: Learn to use AI agents and connected tools for creative work and meeting assistance.
skills: Build a workflow for research, scripts, promotional video and reusable marketing content
Set up scheduling and meeting preparation; connect supported meeting assistants to join calls and capture notes or transcripts
Turn meeting notes into summaries, action lists and follow-up drafts; test the complete workflow

topics.title: WordPress, websites & integrations
topics.description: Extend your website-building skills into WordPress and connected business systems.
skills: Plan pages, content, plugins and an effective customer journey
Use AI to improve WordPress layouts, copy and useful functionality
Connect forms, bookings, ecommerce or other services and troubleshoot common problems

topics.title: Software services & AI training
topics.description: Learn to package what you build and teach practical AI skills to other people.
skills: Price software, licensing, automation audits and ongoing service packages
Prepare a practical AI curriculum and proposal for businesses or institutions
Practise workshop facilitation and present your software and a short training session

full.title: Complete Business & AI Programme — Both Phases
full.headline: Create your business. Then build with AI.
full.audience: Learners who want the complete journey: business creation and marketing, followed by AI, coding, WordPress, software development and institutional training.
outcomes: Everything in Business Creation & Digital Foundations
Everything in AI, Coding & Software Development
36 scheduled private lessons across both phases
Save VUV 50,000 compared with booking separately
Three months of follow-up mentorship after both training phases
full.overview: Learn both sets of practical skills in sequence: create and market your business, then build your chosen software and AI agent workflows. The complete package includes both project journeys and three months of mentorship after both phases.
full.projectTitle: Create the business. Build the software behind it.
full.projectDescription: Complete your business launch project in the first phase, then build one software project of your choice in the second. Connect marketing, customer workflows and AI agents around your goals, with three months of follow-up mentorship after both phases.
projectSteps: Build your business and customer offer
Launch your website, store and marketing
Build your chosen software and AI workflows
